parsed.post: The attempt to increase batch size caused a regression (0.871 vs 0.847). Reverting to the best configuration (1c4ec43). I suspect the 5-minute window is too tight for larger batches to converge effectively. I will now try to refine the learning rate and warmup ratio to achieve more stable convergence in the current window.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR slightly to speed up convergence and increasing WARMUP_RATIO to stabilize the early training phase within the limited 5-minute budget.
